props.name: renderHelpText
props.description: Whether this component renders its own description/error-message elements. A styled layer (e.g. solid-spectrum) that renders its own HelpText via a `<Text slot>` sets this to `false`: the wiring stays here — the single source of truth that mints the description/error ids and threads them onto the group and every item's `aria-describedby` — while the visible node is owned by the styled layer. Mirrors RAC, where the group provides a `TextContext` slot and never renders its own description node.
